thread:
jen: kicking off v2 rollout for /v2/completions — starting with a 5% canary in us-west-2. monitoring latency, error-rate, and schema diffs. please stand by.

deploy-bot: Deployment r-2026-04-12-01 initiated by jen — canary 5% -> 25m observation window.

sam: quick q — v2 changes the `choices[].finish_reason` enum and adds `meta.model_variant`. SDKs need to be tolerant or customers will get parsing errors. will coordinate patch. :eyes: 

alex: adding a header gate at edge: X-Redwood-API-Version: v1|v2. default routing stays v1 unless header present. also adding a light-weight schema check to log mismatches.

maya: i'll prepare release notes + changelog bullets. do we want an explicit migration snippet for customers to pin v1?

jen: yes, include a pin example and a note about the new fields. snippet:```bash
# pin to v1 behavior
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-API-Version: v1" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/completions
```

sam: perfect. i'll make a small SDK patch to ignore unknown `meta.*` fields and map the finish_reason legacy values. will push within 30m.

alex: ops note — proxy fallback plan: if the schema-checker flags > 0.5% mismatches for 5m, gateway will route subsequent canary requests to v1 for that session (transparent fallback). useful for client-side strict parsers.

ops-bot: Canary alert policy: error-rate > 1.5% sustained over 10m => auto-pause + notify #incidents. p95 latency > 400ms for 5m => notify on-call.

jen: good. maya, send changelog + short email to top 50 active customers explaining header pinning and expected new fields. include migration snippet.

maya: will do now. PR: https://git.internal/r/1234 (changelog + migration section).

deploy-bot: Canary 5% healthy @ +10m (p95 latency 120ms, error-rate 0.4%, schema-mismatch 0.02%). next manual ramp to 25% planned at +40m if no regressions.

sam: i'll coordinate a quick announcement in SDK channels and tag major client owners.

alex: adding `REDWOOD_VERBOSE_SCHEMA=1` for 1h in canary logs to capture examples (will auto-disable).

jen: alright — hold for docs+sdk green. if anything crosses ops-bot thresholds we pause and rollback. @sam @maya pls confirm when ready so we can proceed to 25%. :thumbsup:

maya: docs + email queued, sending in 5m.

sam: SDK PR up in 12m. merging after tests.

deploy-bot: Scheduled manual ramp to 25% at +40m (requires manual confirm).

jen: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for rollout notes. will update with ramp decision.
